scope: First published-catalogue census, architectural floor-space scenarios and broad regional exclusions.
numerical_controls: Independent sum of five annular building strips and diameter-squared population scaling.
Every adopted rounded population lies within 2.5 percent of its unrounded floor-space calculation.
Pole, antimeridian and pixel-boundary water-cell controls.
Bilinear climate sampling against an analytic field and its periodic longitude seam.
Unsorted synthetic catalogue rows, inclusive diameter caps, missing depth and changed-input rejection.
Depth, source quality, rainfall, temperature and water exclusion boundaries.
The exported candidate list reproduces stage totals and independently summed floor-space populations.

source_checks.archive_integrity: Complete CSV streamed to EOF; ZIP CRC and the recorded archive SHA-256 verified.
source_checks.source_reading: Publisher abstract and availability statement, official dataset README, CSV header and records. Full article methods remain unread.
source_checks.field_difference: The README describes three extra fields absent from the twelve-column full CSV. The calculation uses present fields and retains the secondary flag without a cut.

evidence: Numerical and software verification of a count on published detections and modelled regional masks. Local site suitability and engineering remain to be assessed.

editorial.purpose: Give the project author and future contributors a reproducible first terrain inventory against the adopted settlement design.
editorial.voice: Technical report, with adopted choices, model outputs and enclosure proposals distinguished.
editorial.review: Read the complete new report, design brief and added synthesis passages in context against the common, public/professional and scholarly profiles; verified table values against the saved product. Markdown prose uses one paragraph per line.

remaining: Full reading of the original crater-catalogue methods and an independent catalogue comparison.
Finer rim and lake-level profiles, estate spacing, local water supply, foundations, access and heritage evaluation.
Pressure-envelope structure, shielding, anchors and failure containment for vacuum-era enclosures.
